description:
A modern C++20 web framework designed for performance, type safety, and a great developer experience.

Mach is a modern C++20 web framework for building fast, type-safe web applications and APIs, with a focus on performance and developer experience.
Mach 1.0.0 is the first stable release of Mach, featuring routing and minimal APIs, controller-based APIs, model binding and JSON serialization, validation, middleware, CORS and CSRF protection, centralized error handling, configuration, logging, the Mach CLI, CMake integration, and Windows and Linux support.
